description: This Java class 'ImageManagementHelper' provides utility methods to retrieve internal image URLs for products within the Apache OFBiz framework. It queries product content data from the database based on product ID and content type, returning the URL of the default or image content if available.

classes.name: ImageManagementHelper
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for image URL retrieval in product management context.

methods.name: getInternalImageUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the internal image URL for a product based on its product ID, checking for default images first, then other images if necessary.
